messages:
Nina (Hiring Ops): Heads-up: multiple interviewers just reported that the scorecard shown in the ATS truncates behavioral prompts. Looks like longer scenario text gets cut off in the web view. Affects afternoon loop.

Ben (Recruiter): I noticed a couple of notes from interviewers who said the last paragraph of the scenario was missing. I pulled an export and the CSV has full text, so this is a rendering issue in the UI.

Ola (People Ops): Is this new? We updated the checklist renderer last month to support markdown. Could be a change there.

Sam (Eng Manager): Can you paste a short example? Helps repro.

Ben (Recruiter): Sample from export (sanitized): 

```csv
candidate_id,role,interviewer,scenario_text,eval_url
55521,Backend,Lee,"Design a retry strategy for idempotent writes. Consider visibility, duplicate suppression, and latency constraints.",https://hr/evals/55521
```

Nina (Hiring Ops): In the UI the text shows only "Design a retry strategy for idempotent writes." and cuts before the rest. Seems like the renderer drops text after the first sentence when markdown flag is enabled.

ats-bot: UI error 1799998890 \u2014 text_renderer failed to parse markdown_safe on field scenario_text for template tmpl-77 (stacktrace attached).

Ola (People Ops): Immediate mitigation: I'll roll back the markdown flag on checklist-renderer for prod checklists so interviewers see full plain text. That should be quick.

Nina (Hiring Ops): Please also create a temporary note at top of calendar invites telling interviewers to open the eval_url if they need full context until fixed.

Sam (Eng Manager): Can eng investigate whether the markdown sanitizer strips after first punctuation by accident? Might be a regex bug.

Ben (Recruiter): Quick rollback command: `kubectl set env deployment/checklist-renderer MARKDOWN_SAFE=false -n prod` — I'll coordinate with infra.

Nina (Hiring Ops): We've paused automated external sends for the affected interviews. Sending manual holds to external interviewers now.

Ola (People Ops): Rollback done, health checks green after 30s. Ran a quick smoke view -> scenario_text displays full content.

Sam (Eng Manager): I'll file ENG-4567 to track root cause: probable sanitizer regex bug when handling multiline inputs. Assigning to frontend-rendering. Also planned unit test to include long scenario paragraphs.

Ben (Recruiter): Thanks. Once ENG-4567 has a fix we should re-enable markdown flag and run a canary showing both markdown and plain checklists.

Nina (Hiring Ops): Noted. I'll unblock the interviewers and update the hiring channel when the canary is done. Closing for now, ping this thread if anything else pops up.
